rows.grounds: compound of svāhā (ritual utterance) and pada (word); accusative object
temporal or sequential adverb following prior instruction
compound of śukra (semen) and śuddhi (purification); subject of bhavet

items.question: By what utterance is the purification of semen accomplished after the prior rite?
premises: The svāhā utterance is prescribed as the operative word.
The instruction follows the prior purification of kula nectar.
The purification of semen is stated as the resulting condition.
items.inference: Uttering the svāhā word brings about the purification of semen.
uncertainties: The precise ritual referent of śukra in this context is not fully specified within the verse.
items.plain_english: Then, O goddess, O beloved, the utterance 'svāhā' should bring about the purification of the semen.
